data_request: รายการเงินฝากและโอนเงินของบัญชีผู้ชำระ (รหัสรายการ, วันเวลา, บัญชีต้นทาง, บัญชีปลายทาง, ยอดเงิน) เพื่อดูการรับโอนและส่งต่อเงิน

conventions.entities: DUP-PAY and DUE-NEAR name the contract (contract_id), PAYER-MULTI the payer (payer_id)
conventions.period: findings of a pattern over several periods carry the latest period of the data, 2026-08; the duplicate payment carries its own month, 2026-05
conventions.status: rows with status C are cancelled and are excluded by the brief (conditions); none of them takes part in a planted case
conventions.refunds: negative pay_amount rows are refunds (about 2 % of the rows); they are not findings, they are why "ยอดชำระสุทธิ" conflicts with the data
conventions.suggested_risks: C-R3 is the only library risk with a planted case that the auditor did not request (duplicate payment + refunds); G-R3 would need time of day, which payments lack; G-R1/G-R2/G-R4 have no planted case in C
conventions.concern_risks: concern 3 (payer accounts receiving unusual transfers) is a data type E risk, R1; it needs deposit/transfer transactions the file does not have, hence "ไม่พอ" and a data request
conventions.benford: the instalments are stratified Benford (1,000-39,999) so first digits follow Benford (MAD < 0.006) and no amount is a modified-z outlier
